subject: Joint Demo Roadshow + Webinar Series — CircularSphere x Redwood
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@circularsphere.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: partners@circularsphere.com
Date: 2026-09-29T08:32:00+02:00
Subject: Redwood x CircularSphere — idea: demo roadshow + partner webinar series

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well. CircularSphere is planning a small partner activation in Q4 focused on mid-market engineering teams in EMEA: a three-city demo roadshow (London, Berlin, Amsterdam) paired with a two-part technical webinar series.

Wethink Redwood would be a great co-presenter for the webinar and a shared-booth partner for the roadshow. High level proposal:
- Shared booth at each city (split staffing 50/50, small footprint 3m x 2m)
- Two 45-min technical webinars (recorded) co-branded, target 400 registrants total
- MDF request: 2k total (cover venue catering, local ads, and booth materials)
- We can host registration pages and handle local logistics; Redwood would provide demo engineers and hero content (1 keynote + 1 live demo)

Attaching our sponsor package and a preliminary agenda for the roadshow. Can you let me know who on your side should be in the conversation (ops, marketing, sales)? Also any hard nos on the MDF number?

Looking forward,

Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships, CircularSphere
[Attachment: CircularSphere_SponsorPkg_v3.pdf (PDF, 480KB)]
[Attachment: RSW-CS-roadshow-agenda-draft.xlsx (Excel, 32KB)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@circularsphere.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T12:15:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CircularSphere — idea: demo roadshow + partner webinar series

Hi Elena (and partners),

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments  nice work. This is interesting and aligned to the kinds of regional activations weve prioritized for Q4. A few quick notes from my side:

- Redwood can commit to co-presenting the webinars and fielding two demo engineers per city (costs/fees below).
- MDF: open to discussing the 2k ask; we typically look for a 60/40 split on partner-funded local ads when we are the second sponsor. Could CircularSphere consider that split?
- Booth staffing: we can provide travel stipend + 2 field seats per date; Marissa and Ben  can you confirm ops/field budget and staffing availability for the dates in the draft?
- Recording & content: wed like to add a short customer success vignette in the webinar to help conversions. Do you have a customer willing to join?

Marissa, Ben, Kimberly  please review the attached and confirm what we can sign off on quickly (especially MDF cadence and booth footprint). Elena, if those org-level asks sound OK I can draft a one-page mutual action plan and a simple MDF term sheet we can both sign.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: RSW-CS-roadshow-agenda-draft.xlsx]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T09:03:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CircularSphere — idea: demo roadshow + partner webinar series

Quick ops check from Field Marketing:

- Dates: the draft shows 11/16 London, 11/18 Berlin, 11/20 Amsterdam. Those are plausible but tight for travel. We prefer pushing last city to 11/22 to allow shipping and rest.
- MDF: 2k total is workable if CircularSphere covers venue & local ads and Redwood covers travel stipends + local handler fees. If theyre asking us for cash, wed want a 60/40 or performance-based tranche (50% upfront for materials, 50% after attendance thresholds).
- Booth: 3m x 2m footprint is OK but needs a small AV rack for live demo (well need power and dedicated table). Please confirm venue power specs.
- Recording: we need a release form for the webinar recordings; legal can use our standard media release.

Ben: tag you for budget approval (I estimate ~15k total from Redwood if we pay the 40% split + travel stipends).

Marissa
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@circularsphere.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: partners@circularsphere.com
Date: 2026-10-02T10:22:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CircularSphere — idea: demo roadshow + partner webinar series

Hi everyone,

Thanks  that all sounds reasonable. A few clarifications from our side:
- Dates: we can move Amsterdam to 11/22, London stays 11/16, Berlin 11/18.
- MDF split: CircularSphere is OK with the 60/40 split (well cover venue + ads). Wed like Redwood to commit the 40% as a refundable credit against pipeline (standard for us: credit issued if net-new pipeline attributable to the campaign exceeds 00k within 90 days).
- Customer vignette: yes, we have a mid-market customer in London thats willing to join the webinar and do a short case study clip.
- Attachments: updated sponsor package with the performance-credit clause included (attached).

If that all looks good Ill ask our legal team to route a short partner MOU and the performance credit terms to your legal contact.

Elena
